purpose: Truth-free identification audit of Android per-satellite AccumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters using the existing eligible TDCP closure residual; no native correction is permitted before all frozen gates pass.

phase54_policy.use: next-factor policy only; no Phase54 metric payload is an audit input

source_semantics.meaning: absolute single-sided 1-Sigma uncertainty of the accumulated delta range
source_semantics.availability: status follows AccumulatedDeltaRangeState; finite positive values only enter u_pair
source_semantics.pair_sigma_m: sqrt(u_prev_m^2 + u_curr_m^2), coefficient exactly 1, no clip or tuning
source_semantics.adr_validity: ADR_STATE_VALID=1; RESET=2 and CYCLE_SLIP=4 clear for ordinary pair; half-cycle bits are retained as state groups, not silently discarded
source_semantics.phase53_relation: Phase53 physical no-go and Phase54 integrity recovery are policy metadata only; no prior metric payload is read

fixed_observable.raw_pseudorange: Phase25 long-double/integer raw-clock contract only for finite eligibility; no coordinates or truth
fixed_observable.center: subtract median signed closure residual in each endpoint utcTimeMillis+HardwareClockDiscontinuityCount group using ordinary pairs
fixed_observable.pair_eligibility: 0 < dt <= 1.5 s, unchanged HCDC/segment, finite in-range Phase25 raw pseudorange, existing code/CN0/multipath masks clear, ADR VALID and RESET/CYCLE_SLIP clear, both uncertainty values finite and >0 for the uncertainty population
fixed_observable.grouping: route, constellation/signal/frequency, satellite, ADR state class, fixed uncertainty bins and route quartiles
fixed_observable.common_mode: raw and centered signed residual retained; all relation gates use centered absolute residual
fixed_observable.control: ordinary TDCP closure residual without uncertainty weighting; no solver or correction
fixed_observable.repeat: no second raw read; deterministic in-memory recomputation only

numeric_gates.logic: AND; all thresholds fixed before first raw read; no result-dependent tuning

native_implementation_policy.before_all_gates_pass: no C++ change, no sigma floor, no solver rerun, no truth
native_implementation_policy.if_all_gates_pass: separately seal one opt-in native C++ TDCP sigma floor max(existing_tdcp_sigma_m,u_pair_m), coefficient 1, no cap, eligible current FGO TDCP factors only; structural repeat/control then stop before truth
native_implementation_policy.if_any_gate_fails: record no-go, preserve Phase43 champion and Phase51 experimental option, name exactly one next source-supported raw physical factor

failure_policy.hash_or_schema_mismatch: fail closed before raw input reads
failure_policy.nonfinite_or_missing_uncertainty: report as unavailable and exclude only the affected uncertainty relation; never impute
failure_policy.no_go: no native implementation or truth; strongest uncertainty/residual structure plus exactly one next raw factor

next_single_raw_physical_factor_if_no_go: raw Android per-satellite BiasUncertaintyNanos/receiver-clock uncertainty relationship
